settings_bookkeeping.series_help: Which series is preselected for manual bookkeeping. Can be changed per voucher.
settings_bookkeeping.fy_help: Fiscal years are created automatically when you book or import data outside existing years, but you can also set up a new year in advance here. A new year must chain directly onto an existing year, and the prior year may need to be locked first.

settings_salary.format_help: The format of the payment file you upload to your internet bank. pain.001 is the new standard all banks are moving to.
settings_salary.sunset_warning: Swedish banks are retiring Bankgirot Lön during 2026 — Swedbank stops accepting LB salary files on 1 August 2026, other banks during the autumn. Switch to ISO 20022 pain.001 well before your next salary payment.
settings_salary.bank_help: When selected, upload instructions for your bank are shown first on every payroll run.
settings_salary.net_rounding_toggle: Round net pay up to whole kronor
settings_salary.net_rounding_help: Net pay is rounded up to the nearest whole krona and the öre difference is booked on account 3740. Enable this if your bank rejects payment files with öre amounts.
settings_salary.vacation_info: The vacation rule (procentregeln 12% by default) and number of vacation days are set per employee.
settings_salary.voucher_series_help: Can be changed per payroll run. Each series has unbroken voucher numbers per fiscal year.
settings_salary.tax_tables_help: Tax tables and municipal tax rates are fetched automatically from Skatteverket's open data on every payroll run. No manual update is needed. If Skatteverket's API is unavailable, an embedded fallback copy is used until the service is back.
settings_salary.info_payroll_scope: The payroll module handles salaries for your employees: tax deductions, employer contributions, vacation pay liability and the employer declaration (AGI). If you run a sole proprietorship (enskild firma), you as the owner take money out via owner's drawings (account 2013), not salary.

salary_payments.title: Payment file for your bank
salary_payments.format_description_bg_lb: Legacy Bankgirot format. Being retired by the banks during 2026 — use pain.001 if your bank supports it.
salary_payments.format_description_pain001: ISO 20022, the payment file standard. Usually requires a file transfer agreement with your bank: several online banks do not accept pain.001 through ordinary file upload.
salary_payments.pain001_agreement_warning: pain.001 is normally delivered through a file transfer agreement or a bankgiro connection, not by uploading it in your online bank. Check that your bank accepts the file that way well before the pay date.
salary_payments.sunset_warning: Swedish banks are retiring Bankgirot Lön during 2026 — Swedbank stops accepting LB salary files on 1 August 2026, other banks during the autumn. Switch to pain.001 in good time.

salary_payments.steps_bg_lb_seb: Betalningar → Filöverföring → choose Bankgiro LB → upload and approve.

salary_payments.steps_bg_lb_nordea: Filimport → Bankgiro LB → upload → approve the payment.
salary_payments.steps_pain001_swedbank: Betala och överföra → Filtjänster → Upload file (ISO 20022 pain.001) → sign with BankID.
salary_payments.steps_pain001_seb: SEB Business Arena does not accept pain.001 through file upload, only CSV, and SEB's SEPA CSV covers EUR payments only. pain.001 to SEB requires a file transfer agreement. Without one, choose the Bankgirot LB file instead for domestic salaries in SEK.
salary_payments.steps_pain001_handelsbanken: Betala → Filimport → ISO 20022 → choose pain.001 → sign.
salary_payments.steps_pain001_nordea: Filimport in Nordea Business → Format pain.001 → upload → approve.

settings_invoice_form.reminder_days_help: Choose how many days after the due date each reminder is sent. The days must be in ascending order.
settings_invoice_form.sending_disabled_notice: Automatic reminder sending is currently disabled in Accounted and no reminder emails go out. Your schedule is saved and takes effect when sending is enabled.
settings_invoice_form.send_reminders_help: When off, no automatic reminder emails are sent to customers with overdue invoices.

settings_payment_links.enable_help: Shows the payment link field in the invoice editor. With Stripe connected, a payment link is created automatically when the invoice is sent.

settings_peppol.enable_help: Publishes the company's Peppol id (0007 + organisation number) through our Peppol access point so suppliers can send e-invoices straight into Accounted. Received invoices land in the supplier invoice inbox. Sending e-invoices needs no registration.
settings_peppol.provider_required: A contracted and configured Peppol access point is required before receiving can be enabled.
settings_peppol.load_failed: Could not read the Peppol status. Reload the page.

settings_peppol.access_disabled: Switched off. Contact support if you want it back.

settings_pdf_print.show_plusgiro_help: Show plusgiro number on invoice printout

settings_pdf_print.credit_terms_placeholder: E.g. Payment is made to the specified bankgiro.

settings_email_texts.description: The texts in the email sent with the invoice. Edit freely: only your changes are saved. Does not apply to credit notes, proforma invoices or delivery notes.

settings_email_texts.placeholders_help: Available placeholders (unknown ones are left as text):

settings_reminder_texts.heading: Reminder texts
settings_reminder_texts.description: The texts in the reminder emails, per reminder level. Edit freely: only your changes are saved.
settings_reminder_texts.level_3_hint: The final reminder is a debt collection warning: the last notice before the claim can be handed to collection.
settings_reminder_texts.placeholders_help: Available placeholders (unknown ones are left as text):

settings_invoice_email_recipients.description: These recipients are added automatically to every invoice email. You can add more recipients when sending an individual invoice.
settings_invoice_email_recipients.cc_hint: Enter one address per line, or separate addresses with commas or semicolons.
settings_invoice_email_recipients.bcc_hint: BCC recipients are hidden from the customer and other recipients.
settings_invoice_email_recipients.too_many_description: You can enter at most {count} fixed CC and BCC addresses in total.
settings_invoice_email_recipients.saved_description: The fixed CC and BCC recipients will be used for the next invoice email.

settings_invoice_sender_domain.heading: Invoice email sender
settings_invoice_sender_domain.description: By default invoice emails are sent from our address with your company name as the sender. To send them from your own domain instead, for example faktura@yourcompany.se, add the domain here and publish the DNS records with your domain provider. The emails are then signed with your domain, and recipients' spam filters see you, not us.

settings_invoice_sender_domain.fallback_note: Until the domain is verified, or while it is paused, invoices are sent exactly as before from our address.
settings_invoice_sender_domain.enabled_hint: Pause to temporarily go back to our address without removing the domain.

settings_invoice_sender_domain.enabled_off: Off: invoice emails are sent from our address.

settings_invoice_sender_domain.name_hint: The name the recipient sees. Leave empty to use the company name.

settings_invoice_sender_domain.remove_confirm: Remove {domain}? Invoice emails will go from our address again.

A foreign-currency account needs an IBAN, or for USD/GBP a bank code, account number and BIC/SWIFT.

settings_period_locking.auto_lock_help: Automatically locks periods after the chosen number of days.

settings_voucher_series.empty_state: No voucher series yet. Series {series} is created automatically with the first voucher.

settings_booking_templates.title: Bookkeeping templates
settings_booking_templates.description: Reusable templates for common bookkeeping transactions. Standard templates are shown to everyone; you can create and share your own.
settings_booking_templates.toast_export_timeout: The export took too long. No file was saved. Try again.
settings_booking_templates.toast_hidden: The template is hidden for this company
settings_booking_templates.description_placeholder: When should this template be used?
settings_booking_templates.line_types_help: The line type controls how the amount is split, not which account is booked. Payment is the line where the money actually moves (e.g. 1930 business account) and takes the full amount. Cost/Revenue is what the purchase or sale is about (e.g. 5410 or 3011). VAT is calculated automatically from the total. To be selectable directly on a bank transaction, the template needs exactly one cost/revenue line and one payment line on opposite sides.
settings_booking_templates.unconvertible_hint: This template can't be picked directly when booking a transaction: it's used from a journal entry. To appear in the transaction list, it needs exactly one cost/revenue line and one settlement line on opposite sides.
settings_booking_templates.ratio_help: Share of the total amount booked on this line. The shares should sum to 1.0.
settings_booking_templates.ratio_sum_warning: The shares for cost lines do not sum to 1.0.
settings_booking_templates.duplicate_name_warning: A template with this name already exists.

settings_counterparty_templates.title: Bookkeeping templates
settings_counterparty_templates.description: Learned patterns that suggest postings automatically based on the counterparty. Templates are created from SIE imports and when you approve categorizations.
settings_counterparty_templates.empty_help: Templates are created automatically when you categorize transactions or import a SIE file.

settings_tax_form.entity_form_help: Company form cannot be changed. Contact support if needed.
settings_tax_form.vat_registered_help: Mandatory if turnover exceeds SEK 120,000 per year.
settings_tax_form.vat_taxable_base_over_40m_label: VAT taxable base above SEK 40 million per year
settings_tax_form.vat_taxable_base_over_40m_help: Requires monthly VAT reporting and moves the filing day for both the VAT and employer declarations to the 26th. Deducted tax and employer contributions must still be paid by the 12th. Also select this if Skatteverket has decided that the company files on these dates despite a lower taxable base.
settings_tax_form.vat_has_eu_trade_help: EU purchases or sales affect the yearly VAT deadline.
settings_tax_form.vat_filing_method_label: How is the VAT return filed?
settings_tax_form.vat_filing_method_help: For limited companies with yearly VAT and no EU trade, the date depends on the filing method.
settings_tax_form.periodisk_enabled_help: Applies to VAT-exempt sales of goods or certain services to VAT-registered businesses in other EU countries.
settings_tax_form.periodisk_help: EU goods sales are normally reported monthly (35 ch. 2 § SFL). Services-only sales are reported quarterly by default; quarterly reporting of goods sales requires a decision from Skatteverket.
settings_tax_form.periodisk_filing_method_help: Electronic filing is normally due on the 25th, while paper filing is due on the 20th.
settings_tax_form.tax_contact_help: Used as sender on files to Skatteverket (EU sales list, etc.).
settings_tax_form.fiscal_year_ef_help: Enskild firma must use the calendar year (BFL ch. 3).
settings_tax_form.fiscal_year_change_help: The change affects future fiscal years.
settings_tax_form.pays_salaries_help: Controls the salary module in the menu. Paying out salary requires employer registration with Skatteverket.
settings_tax_form.employer_registered_help: Registered employers must file an employer declaration (AGI) every month, including months without salary payments (nil declaration). Controls AGI deadlines.
settings_tax_form.eu_trade_suggestion_help: There are booked EU sales (accounts 3108, 3308 or 3107) in the last 15 months, but EU trade or the EU sales list is not enabled below. The EU sales list (periodisk sammanställning) must be filed monthly or quarterly when selling to businesses in other EU countries; the late fee is 1,250 kr per report.
settings_tax_form.employer_seasonal_help: Files the employer declaration only for months with salary payments, plus December if no salary was paid during the year.
settings_tax_form.kontrolluppgifter_help: Creates an annual deadline on 31 January for income statements (KU10, KU20, KU31). Covers among other things dividends to owners and interest on owner loans, which are never included in the employer declaration.
settings_tax_form.ku_suggestion_title: Your bookkeeping suggests income statements (KU) are due
settings_tax_form.ku_suggestion_help: There are booked dividends or owner loans (accounts 2898, 2393 or 2893) in the last 15 months. Dividends and interest to owners are reported with a kontrolluppgift by 31 January; they are not part of the employer declaration. The late fee is 500 kr per statement. Enable the reminder below if this applies to your company.
settings_tax_form.rot_rut_label: Remind about the ROT/RUT payout request
settings_tax_form.rot_rut_help: Creates a deadline on 31 January for the ROT/RUT payout request (begäran om utbetalning). The reminder is only created for years with paid ROT/RUT invoices. Missing the date forfeits the Skatteverket payout.
settings_tax_form.rot_rut_suggestion_title: There are invoices with ROT/RUT deductions
settings_tax_form.rot_rut_suggestion_help: The ROT/RUT payout request must reach Skatteverket by 31 January the year after the customer paid (lag 2009:194). Missing the date forfeits the entire payout. Enable the reminder below to have the date tracked automatically.
settings_tax_form.preliminary_tax_monthly_help: Monthly amount per Skatteverket's debited preliminary tax decision. Payment reminders are only created when an amount is set. Leave empty if no preliminary tax is debited.
settings_tax_form.more_deadlines_help: Deadlines that only apply to some companies. Enable the ones that apply to you and the dates are tracked automatically.
settings_tax_form.oss_help: For EU B2C sales above the EUR 10,000 threshold. Due the last day of the month after the quarter; the date does not move for weekends.
settings_tax_form.ioss_help: For distance sales of imported goods (import scheme). Due the last day of the following month; the date does not move for weekends.
settings_tax_form.intrastat_help: SCB's intra-EU trade in goods report, for companies above the thresholds. Due around the tenth working day of the following month. Check SCB's calendar for exact dates.
settings_tax_form.punktskatt_help: For companies liable for excise duties (e.g. alcohol, tobacco, energy). Follows the ordinary tax declaration dates.
settings_tax_form.fyllnadsinbetalning_help: Extra preliminary tax payment to avoid interest on back taxes. Amounts over 30,000 kr by the 12th of the second month after the fiscal year, the rest by the 3rd of the fifth month.

settings_api_keys.empty_help: Create a key to connect your MCP client.
settings_api_keys.copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the text above and copy it manually.

settings_api_keys.other_clients: Other clients: Grok, Claude Code, Cursor, plugin
settings_api_keys.works_with_ai: Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, and other AI assistants.

settings_api_keys.new_key_dialog_description: Copy the key now. It is shown only once.

The authorization is granted once in Skatteverket's Ombud och behörigheter e-service and can be withdrawn there at any time.
settings_skatteverket_connect.system_org_label: Grant the authorization to organisation number
settings_skatteverket_connect.system_cert_expires_soon: {appName}'s certificate with Skatteverket expires in {days} days.
settings_skatteverket_connect.system_deeplink_failed: The link could not be created

settings_skatteverket_connect.needs_reconsent_message: The Skatteverket connection needs to be renewed. Automatic syncing is paused until you reconnect with BankID.

settings_skatteverket_connect.connect_requires_connector_key: Connecting to Skatteverket requires a connector key or your own API credentials
settings_skatteverket_connect.connect_requires_subscription: Connecting to Skatteverket requires a subscription
settings_skatteverket_connect.scope_skahmst: Tax account: file export via E-transport
settings_skatteverket_connect.disabled_message: The Skatteverket integration is temporarily disabled. Contact support.
settings_skatteverket_connect.connect_intro: Connect to Skatteverket with BankID to submit VAT declarations, employer declarations and fetch the tax account balance. When you connect, we immediately fetch the company's tax account balance and transactions and check for pending employer declaration receipts (kvittenser) at Skatteverket.
settings_skatteverket_connect.skahmst_note: On Skatteverket's consent page some permissions may appear as short names without a description, e.g. ska and skahmst (Rubrik saknas). They are the tax account scope names: ska is required to fetch balance and transactions. Approve them.
settings_skatteverket_connect.connect_approve_all: Approve all permissions on Skatteverket's consent page when you connect. If a permission is left unchecked we cannot, for example, fetch the tax account.
settings_skatteverket_connect.refresh_exhausted: Can no longer be refreshed: connect again with BankID
settings_skatteverket_connect.session_lifetime_note: The BankID session with Skatteverket lasts about one hour. After that a new login is needed before anything can be fetched or filed.
settings_skatteverket_connect.missing_skattekonto: The Skattekonto permission is missing: disconnect and reconnect to enable the balance and transactions view.
settings_skatteverket_connect.missing_agd: The employer declaration (AGI) permission is missing: disconnect and reconnect to send AGI directly from accounted. Tokens issued before AGI support was activated lack this scope.
settings_skatteverket_connect.disabled_filings_message: The Skatteverket integration is temporarily disabled. Filings are inactive.

settings_bankid.linked_description: Your account is linked to BankID.

settings_security.set_password_description: You signed in with BankID and have no password yet. Set one to enable 2FA or to sign in when BankID is unavailable.

salary_employee.tax_table_tooltip: Skatteverket's tables 29–42, based on the municipality's total tax rate. Derived automatically from the registered municipality.
salary_employee.tax_column_tooltip: The column in the tax table determines how the withholding is calculated, mainly based on age and income type. Suggested automatically from the personnummer.

salary_employee.tax_no_table_f_skatt: With F-skatt or FA-skatt the person handles their own tax — no tax is withheld and no tax table is needed.
salary_employee.tax_jamkning_tooltip: Enter the percentage from the Skatteverket decision on adjusted withholding. While it is valid, tax is withheld at this percentage instead of according to the tax table.
salary_employee.tax_jamkning_hint: Leave empty if there is no decision. The table applies again once the decision expires.
salary_employee.tax_jamkning_dates_hint: Both dates are required: the decision is only applied within its validity period.

salary_employee.benefits_bike_hint: Skatteverket's standard rule: the first 3 000 kr/year is tax-free. The remainder is taxed monthly.
salary_employee.recurring_help: Active lines are added automatically to every salary run, e.g. a benefit-bike gross salary deduction.
salary_employee.recurring_deduction_hint: Enter as a positive amount; it is deducted from every month's pay. Gross deductions reduce the tax and employer-fee bases; net deductions come out after tax.
salary_employee.recurring_window_hint: The line is included in salary runs whose payment date falls inside the period (bounds inclusive). No proration for partial months.

data_analysis.settings_toggle_label: Allow the company's bookkeeping data to be used for analysis
data_analysis.settings_toggle_help: Off by default. When on, the company's bookkeeping data is used together with other companies that made the same choice, to evaluate and improve automatic booking. Two things are included. Continuously: booking outcomes, that is which account was proposed, which account was actually booked, the amount and the model's confidence. During Accounted's own evaluation runs: also transaction descriptions, counterparty names and data from matched supporting documents (receipts and invoices), which are then re-run through the same AI model and the same processors as regular booking. Such text can contain personal data, for example names in Swish payments. The data is never used for marketing and never leaves Accounted or the processors listed in the privacy policy. Switching it off stops collection immediately.
